1. (Currently amended) A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, __a compound of formula I as defined in claim 6__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II, selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

2. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4 __or a compound of formula I as defined in claim 6__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof, an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II, selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

3. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4 __or a compound of formula I as defined in claim 6__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II, selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt or ester thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

4. (Currently amended) A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 3, wherein components (I) and (II) are suitable for sequential, separate and/or simultaneous use in the treatment of hypertension and/or conditions characterised by microvascular dysfunction and/or lesions.

5. (Currently amended) A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 4, wherein the condition is hypertension, diabetic retinopathy, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis and/or glomerulosclerosis.

14. 15. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 14, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II is a compound selected from the group consisting of eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan or candesartan cilexetil.

16. (Currently amended) A method of making a kit of parts as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, which method comprises bringing a component (I), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, into association with a component (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, thus rendering the two components suitable for administration in conjunction with each other.

17. (Currently amended) A kit of parts comprising: (1) one of components (I) and (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15; together with (2) instructions to use that component in conjunction with the other of the two components.
